---

## Technical Philosophy & Interview Answers

### Philosophy & Approach
- **Personality Over Generic Templates**: Websites should feel memorable, responsive, and tactile rather than corporate boilerplate.
- **Frontend Performance**: Measure before optimizing. Eliminate unnecessary JS bundles, lazy-load 3D WebGL assets, optimize images to modern formats (WebP/AVIF), and guarantee 60fps micro-interactions.
- **Clean TypeScript Workflows**: Strict types, reusable component systems, and clear state management that makes codebases easy to scale and maintain.

### Production Bug Handling
- Reproduce the issue locally and analyze logs and user impact.
- Isolate the smallest failing path.
- Ship a minimal targeted hotfix or rollback safely if user-facing downtime is at risk.
- Add regression guards or unit tests to prevent recurrence.

### Collaborative Disagreements
- Align on the core product goal and user need.
- Objectively compare tradeoffs based on performance, maintainability, and user experience.
- Choose the option that best serves the product and client rather than personal ego.

## Detailed Project Case Studies

### 1. UAE ATS Resume Generator AI
- **Live URL**: https://emiratescv.in
- **Overview**: An AI-driven resume optimization and generator application engineered specifically for modern Applicant Tracking System (ATS) parsing standards.
- **Key Features**:
  - Direct job-description keyword matching to increase recruiter callback rates
  - Clean ATS-compliant layout generation
  - Curated recruiter feedback scoring engine
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, AI/LLM API, Tailwind CSS, Next.js.

### 2. Viziona
- **Live URL**: https://viziona.com
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/tanie-lalwani/viziona
- **Overview**: A modern responsive web application shaped around intuitive interaction design, UI/UX consistency, and practical product execution.
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, UI/UX Design System.

### 3. FinchPay (Checkout Performance Overhaul)
- **Live Showcase**: https://tanie.me/projects
- **Overview**: A deep frontend performance overhaul pass focused on accelerating checkout flows, clarifying transaction states, and eliminating UI friction during payment.
- **Key Features**:
  - Reduced checkout drop-off through sub-second transition states
  - Streamlined micro-interactions and instant feedback
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Performance Auditing, State Architecture.

### 4. Leafline (Marketing Site Rebuild)
- **Live Showcase**: https://tanie.me/projects
- **Overview**: A modern frontend rebuild focusing on tighter content hierarchy, responsive typography, and a calm, nature-inspired visual design system.
- **Tech Stack**: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Responsive Web Design.

### 5. Interactive 3D Portfolio (tanie.me)
- **Live URL**: https://tanie.me
- **Overview**: An ocean-inspired creative portfolio featuring custom WebGL water shaders, 3D interactive physics, fluid cursor effects, dynamic sound design, and smooth scroll mechanics.
- **Tech Stack**: Three.js, WebGL, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Lenis, Framer Motion.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q: How does Tanie work with clients?**
A: Tanie collaborates remotely as an independent creative developer and engineer with founders, agencies, and businesses worldwide.

**Q: What is the typical project turnaround time?**
A: Landing pages and sprints typically take 1 to 2 weeks. Full interactive web applications, 3D WebGL experiences, or custom portfolio builds generally take 2 to 4+ weeks depending on scope.

**Q: Can Tanie build custom 3D WebGL websites?**
A: Yes. Tanie specializes in Three.js and WebGL interactive 3D web experiences, from interactive product showcases to complete spatial web worlds.

**Q: How do I get in touch or request a quote?**
A: You can reach Tanie through the contact form at https://tanie.me/contact or directly by emailing tanielalwani@gmail.com.
